name: super-editor-control
description: Drive the Super Media Editor (super-editor) from Codex: open courseware in a browser, inspect and edit slides/blocks/elements, group, undo/redo and save via a window bridge.

interface.shortDescription: 用 Codex 控制超媒编辑器完成课件创作与优化
